split: Adaptively selected development comparisons; no held-out or generalization-rate claim.
selection: The twelve named completed matrices below were selected for a robustness-development comparison. This is not an exhaustive history of every attempted variant.
limitations: Matrices differ, seeds and scenes repeat, and candidate changes were guided by these outcomes. Group and case denominators describe their own matrices only. Do not combine successes into a generalization success rate.
runtime_boundary: CPU policy. RGB-D, wrist RGB, camera calibration, robot proprioception/IK, and public task goals only; no simulator object truth or evaluator feedback is returned to the policy.
sensor_scope: Each group sensor is verified against every included result. Historical manifests lacking sensor metadata are supplemented by their recorded per-trial sensor fields.
success_definition: Recorded evaluator success, including physical tower stability; policy completion notes alone are not success.
artifact_scope: Portable public goals, candidate hashes, sensor settings, evaluation outcomes, policy errors and final policy notes only. No images, rollout states, object truth, or absolute paths.

development_interpretations.finding: Typed finite-geometry conflict handling exposed failures previously hidden by fallback estimates; some contradictions arose from edge-depth outliers rather than a genuinely incompatible block model.
development_interpretations.scope: Development diagnostics. Whole-candidate comparisons include other changes and do not isolate a causal effect of the guard.

development_interpretations.finding: A geometry exception immediately after release could previously prevent the remaining robot withdrawal. Release and withdrawal recovery were revised during this sequence.
development_interpretations.scope: Control-flow limitation identified during development; successful opening alone is not evidence of completed placement or safe withdrawal.

development_interpretations.finding: Finite-extent robustness was revised first with inward trimming, then with observed-halfspace constraints, while retaining explicit model-conflict handling.
development_interpretations.scope: The per-snapshot outcomes below retain both regressions and recoveries; they are not a pooled robustness rate.

development_interpretations.finding: Initial noncube dimensions remain vulnerable to partial silhouettes: observed extents can be lower bounds rather than full physical dimensions. This issue remained under active development after v21.
development_interpretations.scope: Do not interpret these snapshots as solving general dimension recovery or orientation transfer.
